title: Real artists still ship
summary: Short post on a 100k-developer study: AI tools sharply raise commits but the effect shrinks for projects and releases, so coding faster is not shipping more.

assertions.quote: HUGE productivity boost, MINOR shipping boost.
the 180% cumulative effect falls to 50% for the number of projects, and to 30% for actual releases
Do I code faster than ever? Absolutely. But am I shipping more than ever? I can't say that I am
